::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## What the symbols mean

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:------:|:--------|
| $x$ | The **base** |
| $a$, $b$ | **Exponents** |
| $x^a$ | For a whole number $a$: the product of $a$ factors of $x$. Example: $x^3 = x \cdot x \cdot x$ |
| $x^0$ | $x^0 = 1$ for every $x \neq 0$ |
| $x^{-a}$ | $x^{-a} = \frac{1}{x^a}$ for $x \neq 0$ (the reciprocal of $x^a$) |
:::
